packages/psx.enhancement.cd-speed/1.0.0/:
format_version = 5
id = "psx.enhancement.cd-speed"
version = "1.0.0"
name = "CD Speed"
author = "psxrecomp"
description = "Emulated CD drive speed. Shortens loads without speeding the game up, so it does not disturb movement or timing-based routes."
resolver = "declarative"
save_compatibility = "shared"

# Loading speed is a property of the emulated hardware, not of any particular
# disc, so this ships with the framework and applies to every game.
[[target]]
game_id = "*"

[[feature]]
id = "cd-speed"
name = "CD Speed"
description = "Disabled by default. Divides the emulated sector delay, so the drive delivers data sooner while the game itself keeps running at normal speed. Unlike host pacing this changes WHEN the game receives CD interrupts, so a high value can expose timing bugs -- raise it gradually and back off if a load stalls. FMV and CD audio always keep authentic timing."
group = "Quality of Life"
default_enabled = false

[[option]]
feature = "cd-speed"
id = "multiplier"
label = "CD speed multiplier"
description = "1 is authentic 1x. Try 2-32; higher is faster but likelier to trip a timing bug. Any positive value is accepted so you can find this game's limit. Ignored while Instant is ticked."
group = "Quality of Life"
type = "integer"
min = 1
max = 1024
step = 1
default = 4
disabled_by = "instant"

[[option]]
feature = "cd-speed"
id = "instant"
label = "Instant (bounded scheduler)"
description = "Deliver sectors as fast as the bounded instant scheduler allows instead of using a multiplier. Fastest and riskiest."
group = "Quality of Life"
type = "boolean"
default = "false"

[[option]]
feature = "cd-speed"
id = "instant_budget"
label = "Instant sectors per frame"
description = "How many sectors the instant scheduler may deliver per frame. Lower is gentler on games that dislike bursts. Only used while Instant is ticked."
group = "Quality of Life"
type = "integer"
min = 1
max = 256
step = 1
default = 32

[[plugin]]
feature = "cd-speed"
id = "psx.cd-speed"
format_version = 5
id = "psx.enhancement.fast-loading"
version = "1.0.0"
name = "Fast Loading (host pacing)"
author = "psxrecomp"
description = "Speeds up the wall-clock pacing of loads without changing anything the game can observe. Every guest frame, CD interrupt and callback still happens on schedule."
resolver = "declarative"
save_compatibility = "shared"

# Loading speed is a property of the emulated hardware, not of any particular
# disc, so this ships with the framework and applies to every game.
[[target]]
game_id = "*"

[[feature]]
id = "fast-loading"
name = "Fast Loading (host pacing)"
description = "Disabled by default. Host pacing is the safe accelerator: it only changes how fast real time is fed to a load, so the guest cannot desync. It does speed the game up while a load is detected, which some speedrun routes rely on NOT happening -- if that is you, leave this off and use CD Speed instead."
group = "Quality of Life"
default_enabled = false

[[option]]
feature = "fast-loading"
id = "multiplier"
label = "Host speed multiplier"
description = "How much faster than real time a load may run. 1 is authentic. 2-32 is the useful range; larger values keep working but stop helping once the host, not the pacing, is the limit. Ignored while Uncapped is ticked."
group = "Quality of Life"
type = "integer"
min = 1
max = 1024
step = 1
default = 4
disabled_by = "uncapped"

[[option]]
feature = "fast-loading"
id = "uncapped"
label = "Uncapped (as fast as the host allows)"
description = "Run loads at whatever speed this machine can manage, ignoring the multiplier above."
group = "Quality of Life"
type = "boolean"
default = "false"

[[plugin]]
feature = "fast-loading"
id = "psx.fast-loading"
